"Low altitude flight..."
Launching Dyson Sphere components into Dyson Sphere orbit to form a Dyson Sphere.
No overclock and no extra parallel.
Higher tier of Elevator motor Module means faster launching.
Inputting Space Warper will enable overlord mode. Reduce launch intervals.
Joining the wireless EU network when without installing an energy hatch.

[note]Tip[/note] The Dyson Sphere line: the Launch Site sends modules into orbit, the Ray Receiving Station turns the sphere's light into EU, and the Artificial Star burns antimatter for power.

[note]Hatches[/note]: Input Bus, Output Bus, Energy Hatch
[note]Structure[/note]: Cosmic Neutronium Frame Boxes; Space Elevator casings; the casings in the optional task.
Use a Hologram Projector (or the NEI structure preview) to see and auto-build the structure.
